Help me research class-action settlements I may qualify for using Fairshare:
https://github.com/oh-ashen-one/fairshare

Read README.md and AGENT_GUIDE.md first. If GitHub’s page won’t load, try the plain-text guide:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oh-ashen-one/fairshare/main/AGENT_GUIDE.md
If you can’t read the guide or search the live web, tell me before proceeding.

Start with a brief privacy explanation. Ask only for optional context: my country/state, products and apps I’ve used (up to 10 to start), approximate dates, and past employers if I want to include them. I can skip anything. Don’t ask for my name, address, account credentials, IDs, or financial details to start.

Research broadly, then verify each potential match against official settlement notices and administrator websites. Distinguish open claims from closed cases, investigations, and proposed settlements. Never guess eligibility, deadlines, or payouts.

Do the research with the context I give you; ask a follow-up only when it would resolve a specific eligibility question. Start with a short, dated list: claim name, why I might qualify, potential payout in dollars (only a sourced amount or range, otherwise “not yet determined”), deadline, and the official filing link. Label caps and estimates; don’t add speculative payouts into a total. Put proof requirements, unknowns, sources, and search gaps after the shortlist. No matches is a valid result.

Help me understand and prepare truthful answers, but don’t submit, sign, accept terms, or contact anyone for me. I will review and file myself. Don’t save my personal details unless I ask, and never put them in Git or public search queries.

What happens to my information?+

Fairshare has no account, intake form, or personal-data database. It never receives the details you tell your agent. Your AI provider may process that conversation—even if its app runs locally. Hosting providers may process standard request logs and security cookies. Privacy details ↗

Will I definitely get money?+

No. Your agent finds potential matches and checks official sources; the settlement administrator determines eligibility. Amounts may be estimates, caps, or not yet determined. You review the rules and submit yourself. This is research assistance, not legal advice.

What do I need to get started?+

An AI agent that can read the guide and browse the live web. Start with your country or state and a few apps, services, or employers you want checked. No name needed. The source guide is U.S.-focused; other countries have coverage gaps. Fairshare is free; your AI provider may charge for usage. If it can’t read GitHub, use the plain-text guide linked in the prompt.
